data.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

Implement detect-session-leakage.sh to make T1 tests pass.

## Story DD Coverage
DD1, DD2, DD3, DD4

## Implementation Spec

### Scan range
```bash
git log --no-merges "$(git merge-base HEAD "${DSO_MAIN_BRANCH:-main}")"..HEAD --format='%H'
```

### Trailer parsing (per commit)
```bash
_trailers=$(git interpret-trailers --parse < <(git log -1 --format=%B "$sha"))
```
Extract DSO-Story, DSO-Task, DSO-Bug lines via grep.

### Title-to-ID lookup
Use `${DSO_TICKET_CLI:-.claude/scripts/dso} ticket list --type=story` (default JSON array).
Parse with **python3 inline script** (same pattern as apply-attribution-trailers.sh) — NOT grep or jq — to handle titles with special characters:
```python
import json, sys, os
tickets = json.load(sys.stdin)
title = os.environ['_STORY_TITLE']
matches = [t for t in tickets if t.get('title') == title]
# then extract ticket_id and parent_id from single match
```
Hard-fail if 0 or ≥2 matches.
Title extracted from `DSO-Story: ` trailer via: `sed 's/^DSO-Story: //'`

Epic ID: taken from `parent_id` field of matched story object. No `ticket show` call needed.

### 5-case routing discriminator
The discriminator runs for each non-merge commit:
1. Has DSO-Story: trailer AND story is open → cherry-pick to story/<parent_id>/<ticket_id>
2. Has DSO-Task or DSO-Bug trailer BUT no DSO-Story trailer → cherry-pick to story/orphan-<current-branch>
3. Has NO DSO-prefixed trailer at all (commits with only Co-Authored-By etc. = Case 3) → hard-fail with manual-attribution prompt + SHA
4. Has DSO-Story: trailer AND story is closed → hard-fail with --force-route-to usage + candidate open stories in stderr
5. git cherry-pick exits non-zero → git cherry-pick --abort; hard-fail with SHA + conflicting paths

### --force-route-to=<story-id> flag
Epic ID resolved by: `ticket list --type=story` matching ticket_id == story-id, read parent_id.
Validate branch `story/<epic-id>/<story-id>` exists before cherry-picking.
On missing branch: exit 1, print offending SHA + branch-not-found to stderr.

### Orphan routing
Cherry-pick to `story/orphan-$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)`; create branch if absent.

### Conflict detection
On `git cherry-pick` non-zero exit:
- Run `git cherry-pick --abort`
- Print SHA + `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` paths to stderr
- Exit 1

### CLI stub injection
Uses `${DSO_TICKET_CLI:-.claude/scripts/dso}` consistently — NO bare `dso` calls anywhere.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 6 T1 test cases pass
- [ ] ShellCheck passes with no warnings
- [ ] chmod +x applied
- [ ] No bare `dso` calls — always ${DSO_TICKET_CLI:-.claude/scripts/dso}
- [ ] python3 used for JSON parsing (not jq/grep)
- [ ] Exit 0 when no non-merge commits found (no-op case)
- [ ] Unit tests pass (bash tests/scripts/test-detect-session-leakage.sh)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
